note: The bands the Bramor plant has to land in, from docs/BRAMOR-STAGE1.md, which derives each from C-Astral's published figures for the Bramor C4EYE and the drawn planform (scripts/bramor-derive.js). Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

b1_cruise.speed0_source: the flight starts at the Bramor user manual's Best Endurance Speed, VBE 16 m/s, the cruise it is measuring; the shared 12 m/s throw is under the manual's 13 m/s stall (VST)
b1_cruise.source: level speed at the throttle the thrust model says holds the published 16 m/s cruise, derived 16.0

b2_stall.source: the published 13 m/s at 4.5 kg, which is CL max 0.722 on the drawn 0.591 m2; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 0.722 / 4.77; the band the flying wing's, minus 6 and plus 13 percent

b3_glide.source: L/D at the 16 m/s cruise, power off, derived 14.2

b4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 25.0; above the published 22 m/s the autopilot flies to and below the 30 m/s never exceed speed (UST 011)

b5_roll.source: full elevon from level at about 20 m/s, as the helix angle pb/2V, derived 0.103 (82 deg/s at 16 m/s); the band the Cub's, minus 29 and plus 35 percent, for a sideslip the derivation leaves out

b6_turn.source: radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown

b7_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds from 1.1 V_s, the published 5 m/s maximum climb that sized the static thrust

b8_catapult.source: off the rail at 17 m/s and 20 deg (1.3 V_s, ESTIMATED from the photographs), full throttle: never under 1.1 V_s and never under the release height, and 20 m over it after 10 s, where the derived steady climb alone is 4.8 m/s

b9_chop.source: throttle off from cruise, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble

b10_chute_sink.source: descent under the canopy, the last 5 s before touchdown; the canopy was sized for 5.0 m/s, the middle of a small UAS recovery chute's 4.6 to 6.1 m/s (ESTIMATED: C-Astral publishes no rate)

b11_chute_attitude.source: on its back under the canopy: the body's up axis within 15 deg of straight down, the worst of the last 5 s before touchdown

b12_chute_rest.source: at rest on its back after touchdown: within 15 deg of flat, stopped, the CG the winglets' 0.25 m over the ground, the motor stopped

b13_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and the wing's, the Skyhunter's, the Cub's and the Radian's recorded flight hashes in Node, all from before the Bramor existed; the Bramor must move none of them

b14_cross_host.source: the Bramor's catapult flight and its chute descent, state trace hashes, Node against headless Chrome
